rationale.colonization: 主要活动在塔内亚斯陆上，不是海外殖民。
rationale.complexity: 神职特权、部落联盟和形成门槛交织。
rationale.dark_story: 预言政治有压迫风险，但非恐怖叙事主轴。
rationale.difficulty: 先完成制度基础再扩张，未作实机测评。
rationale.diplomacy: 纳迦、兄弟国与部落附庸关系关键。
rationale.early_pressure: 强邻与兄弟竞逐要求早期巩固。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 纳迦预言和宗教特权重要，但没有纯施法循环。
rationale.narrative_density: 选民合法性、兄弟竞争和最终帝国衔接明确。
rationale.tall_play: 河流城市与政府改革重要，但战役偏拓疆。
rationale.trade_economy: 河流运输、港口与贸易是专属主轴之一。
rationale.warfare: 整合边境及竞争者需要军事行动。

identity.appearance: 1444阿拉斯凯蜥蜴人河爪部落，赛卡尔统治，纳迦认可的先驱路线
identity.formation_scope: 符合东萨拉哈尔条件后可形成哈塔拉什亚S81；与L96为并列起始国

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text:
1400年，泽拉特的纳迦因谴责腐朽的安扎拉皇帝而被以叛国罪驱逐出境。这些难民分散到各地部落中，与部落纳迦组织联合起来策划复仇。他们的第一步是寻找一个能够实现纳迦野心的候选人。最终，他们在一位邀请纳迦去教育自己长子的河爪家族酋长的家中寻得了目标。
那名孩子当时只有两岁，正坐在那里写日记，记录今天的冒险经历。这显然让纳迦大吃一惊，因为这绝对不是学习读写的正常年龄。不过，这个年龄正是培养他们所选之人的好时机。儿子的名字叫析卡尔。他将成为实现纳迦野心的人。
description.text_en:
For denouncing the decadent Anzaran emperors in 1400, Zerati nagas were expelled from the country for treason. These refugees dispersed among the local tribes, joining up with their naga structure to plot revenge. Their first step was to look for a candidate capable of enforcing their ambitions. Their search stopped in the house of a Riverclaw chieftain, who brought them in to educate his firstborn.
He was just a two year old, sitting and writing today's adventures in his journal. This obviously surprised the nagas, as this was definitely not a normal age to learn how to read and write. But it was a good age to groom their chosen one. The son's name was Sykar. And he was going to be the one to fulfill the naga's ambitions.

description.text: 双子学院是在拉萨扎纳迟河口处建立的一所大学。未来的人才在两座宏伟的建筑中接受教育，两座建筑由一座横跨卡济纳河的不朽桥梁相连。每一边都有许多学科，西边教授君主之道，东边教授博学者的原则。这里是蜥蜴人社会各阶层的聚集地，从最贫穷的人到酋长和皇帝——你所要做的就是在入学考试中证明自己有足够的能力，成为这所著名学府的学生。
description.text_en: The Twin Academy is a university founded at the entrance of Lasadzanach. There, the minds of the future are educated in two great buildings, connected by a monumental bridge spanning across the Khazynas river. Each side hosts a number of disciplines, the west side teaching the ways of the Sovereign and the east teaching the principles of the Erudite. It’s a place where every layer of lizardfolk society meets, from the poorest to chieftains and emperors - all you have to do is to prove yourself capable enough in the entry exams to become a student of this prestigious establishment.

description.text: 析卡尔成为酋长后首先改变的一件事就是军队，他将散兵游勇的部落民变成一支有组织的军队，引入清晰的指挥系统、规范化的作战阵型、为军队配备青铜武器的公共基金。这些看似普通的理念对拉亚兹人来说却是闻所未闻，而这些改革正是纳迦联军能够与安扎拉帝国久经战阵的职业化军队抗衡的重要原因之一。
description.text_en: One of the first things that Sykar changed when he became the chieftain was to reform the army from a squabble of tribesmen into an organised force. A proper chain of command, standardised formations, a collective fund to supply the army with bronze weapons. These seemingly common ideas were not familiar to the Rayaz before and these improvements were one of the key reasons why the armies of the Naga coalition were able to hold up against professional, battle-hardened armies of Anzara.

description.text: 拉亚兹是分治各方的河爪兄弟之间脆弱联盟的中心。借助影响力极强的纳迦付出的努力，河爪兄弟将分散的部落盟友团结在一起。这些曾与泽拉特交锋的部落们屡受挫败，逐渐气馁，濒临关系断绝的边缘，但有一件事阻止了他们刀剑相向。一个古老的预言描述了三兄弟将带领蜥蜴人进入第333帝国。纳迦宣扬河爪兄弟就是这些预言中的领袖，因此许多部落盟友现在都抱着帮助统一者建立蜥蜴人神选教教义中所谓最终帝国的光荣愿景。
description.text_en: Rayaz was the centerpoint of a vulnerable coalition, split between the Riverclaw brothers, who held together their disparate tribal allies through the unifying efforts of the influential Nagas. These tribes with time became impatient and discouraged by the past war against Zerat, which left them on the verge of breaking ties, but one thing stayed their swords. A prophecy of old, depicted three brothers who would lead the lizardfolk into the 333rd empire. The Nagas preached that the Riverclaws were these prophesied leaders and thus the many tribal allies held onto the glorious vision of helping the Unifier in his attempts to form the Final Empire, foretold to be the final one by the Anzalkatsa teachings.

description.text: 在塔内亚斯丛林中，道路稀少、缺乏维护且陈旧不堪，而河流才是贸易的命脉。河流交汇处最为重要，是贸易商的天然汇合点。拉扎亚斯定居点就位于泽拉特和卡拉斯克之间最常见的贸易路线的交汇处。无论您是安扎拉人还是卡拉斯克人，是卡格拉人还是阿萨尔塔人，甚至是人类，拉亚兹的商人都可以从这里到达您的所在地，帮助您以比日落更快的速度接触新的市场。
description.text_en: Here in the jungles of Taneyas, the roads are rare, unmaintained and obsolete, while the rivers are the lifeblood of trade. Confluences are even more important, serving as a natural joining point for traders. On one of these confluences lies the settlement of Razayas, where the most common trade routes between Zerat and Karassk meet. No matter if you're Anzaran or Karassian, Khugran or Asartan or even human, Rayazas merchants can reach you from there and help you reach new markets faster than the sun sets over the treeline.

description.text: 蜥蜴人丛林的地貌严酷而无情。你永远不知道会踩到什么，除了过河，你的视野都很狭窄。这是游击战的绝佳环境，也是阿拉斯克部落的人能够在众多帝国面前保持自治的原因。绊倒在有毒的花丛中、通往野兽巢穴的道路、桥上的埋伏。这些只是出其不意中的一小部分，任何胆敢未经我们允许擅自闯入的人都将吃尽苦头。
description.text_en: The landscape of the lizardfolk jungles is harsh and unforgiving. You never know what you can step on and your field of view is narrow apart from river crossings. This is a perfect environment for guerilla warfare and it is why the Arraskay tribesmen were able to retain their autonomy from so many empires. A stumble into a toxic flower, a road leading to a wild animal's lair, an ambush on the bridge. Those are only a fraction of many ways you can abuse the element of surprise and anyone who dares enter without our permission will suffer from plenty of them.

description.text: 正如析卡尔大帝的统治为一个庞大政体的出现奠定了基础一样，他儿子「立法者」析卡尔的功绩同样值得颂扬，因为是他构建起一套制度体系，使国家免于在面对争吵不休的部落和安扎拉的死忠派时几近分裂。与他的父亲不同，他完全融入了纳迦的结构，从各个城市召集了最有影响力的学者，与大祭司伊卡提一起编纂法律，使其符合命运雕刻者的道德观，让每只蜥蜴人都能按照蜥蜴人神选教的教义生活。
description.text_en: As much as Sykar the Great's reign laid grounds for a massive polity to emerge, so must the effort of his son Sykar the Lawgiver be preached, as he is the one who built a structure to preserve the state from near-fragmentation at the hand of squabbling tribes and Anzaran loyalists. He, unlike his father, integrated himself fully into the naga structures, brought the most influential scholars from across the cities and along with the High Priest Ikhaty codified the law to correct it in line with the morals of the Sculptors of Fate, making it so every lizard lives according to Anzalkatsa teachings.

description.text: 阿萨尔塔、阿拉津和拉亚兹部落是三个古老的部落，几个世纪以来一直居住在泽拉特和卡拉斯克之间的地区。虽然在他们的大部分历史中，他们依赖于其中一个大城市，有时他们的霸主是不同的，但部落从未忘记他们的纽带，这使他们在几个世纪中紧密相连。
description.text_en: Asarta, Arazin and Rayaz tribes are three ancient tribes, that inhabited the area between Zerat and Karassk for centuries. While for most of their history they were dependent on one of the great cities, and sometimes their overlords were different, tribes never forgot their bonds, which tied them close throughout centuries (placeholder)

description.text: 这三个部落都位于卡拉斯克和泽拉特之间，这使得他们能够控制两个最富有的蜥蜴人城市之间的贸易。
description.text_en: All three tribes are located between Karassk and Zerat, which allows them control the trade between two wealthiest lizardfolk cities. (placeholder)

description.text: 齐亚尼沙是蜥蜴人自古以来就学会制作的薄河船。然而，河流部落学会了用它们来快速移动和突袭敌人，这使他们在河流附近成为一支可怕的力量。
description.text_en: Zianysha - are thin river boats lizardfolk learned to craft since time immemorial. However, river tribes learned to use them for quick movement and raids on their enemies, which allowed them to be a fearsome force near rivers. (placeholder)

description.text: 一个古老的故事预言，一旦所有三个河流部落都被授予领导人，这将使卡拉斯克和泽拉特都在他们的统治下统一起来。
description.text_en: An old tale prophesies that once all three river tribes will be granted leaders, which will unite both Karassk and Zerat under their rule. (placeholder)

description.text: 自古以来，纳迦就对河流部落的青年进行教育，这为他们赢得了河流部落的忠诚度。
description.text_en: Nagas educate youth of river tribes since time immemorial, and that earns them loyalty of river tribes (placeholder)

description.text: 巨大的金属矿藏支持了长期的金属加工传统
description.text_en: Huge deposits of metals supported long tradition of metalworking (placeholder)

player_overview.avoid_if: 希望长时间停留在独特前身树，或不喜欢宗教权威与兄弟竞争的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先稳住纳迦与部落联盟，经营河流边境和港口，再改革政府并争取形成哈塔拉什亚。
player_overview.overview: 拉亚兹是1444年的蜥蜴人部落国家。统治者赛卡尔拥有纳迦的支持，却要同时整合部落、守住人类边境、经营河道与压住兄弟阿萨尔塔的竞争。专属任务树不长，节奏集中在为哈塔拉什亚铺路；形成帝国后才进入更大的共同后续。如果你想玩“预言选民”从部落走向帝国，这条线比兄弟的逆命故事更直接。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢预言正统、蜥蜴人部落整合、河道经营和较快进入帝国篇章的玩家。
signature_features: 纳迦认可的赛卡尔与未被选中的弟弟构成政治对照。
神职支持、部落联盟、河流贸易和边境舰队共同支撑扩张。
16项独立前身任务紧凑地导向共同的最终帝国形成国。
player_overview.tagline: 带领纳迦选中的河爪首领，把分散蜥蜴部落与河流边境筑成最终帝国的起点。

reasons: 纳迦选民视角与兄弟冲突鲜明
河道、防线与部落整合目标紧凑
易于衔接哈塔拉什亚共同后续
warnings: 形成前须处理神职与边境压力

positive_indicators: 建立边境防线保障居民
将分散部落纳入更稳定的政治秩序
values.rationale: 边境保护、河流贸易与部落整合提供公共利益；神职特权和预言竞争集中权力并带来地方自治风险。扩张及君主制改革本身不扣分。
red_flags: 纳迦神职对合法性有强影响
与兄弟和地方部落的权力竞争可能压缩自治
